title: Compaction replacement lacks complete-result validation and overflow fit guarantees
wanted_capability: Commit replacement history only after validated successful summary completion, fit compaction input to the active model, and compact with the previous model before a context-window downshift when necessary.
notes: API-key summary parser accepts accumulated text after clean EOF or an ignored failure event. OAuth remote path accepts arbitrary nonempty output without requiring a summary. Oversized history is sent unchanged to remote compaction. Source-confirmed branches, not live backend failures. See design/bro-harness/agent-loop-context-audit-2026-09-11.md.
resolution_note: Addressed in the agent-loop repair campaign through 5c4ae748. Responses compaction requires successful terminal completion and a validated replacement, fits disposable input on OAuth and API-key paths, and preserves original history on refusal/failure. Live and resumed model downshifts account for current context, compact with the previous model, validate destination occupancy, and checkpoint rejected transitions under the retained model. Mock HTTP rollback/fitting and lifecycle regressions pass. Capacity fitting remains approximate; unknown windows remain provider-validated.
